target_access_rule: Sonic 3 remains excluded until every Gen-3 external validation gate passes. No Gen-3 parameter may change after J.League Pro Striker 2 or Golden Axe II structural features are inspected.
reason_for_new_generation: Gen-2 repaired physical-channel correspondence on Golden Axe III but failed held-out Sonic 3D validation because Maeda recall remained 0.40. Post-failure analysis rejected generic nearest-neighbor hubness as the main cause and found that repeated-note zero intervals dominate many part histograms. Removing repeated-note texture reveals substantially stronger creator separation in both exhausted development worlds.

reference_bank.rule: Validation queries are compared only to this already-developed fixed reference bank. No validation track may become a reference exemplar during validation.

primary_representation.event_source: ordinary full YM2612 key-ons with the same DAC and CH3-special exclusions as Gen-1 and Gen-2
primary_representation.part_definition: one active physical YM2612 channel with at least two ordinary full-FM key-ons

motion_filter.interval_histogram: remove the exact zero-semitone interval bin; retain all nonzero relative-semitone intervals with the existing <-24 and >24 clipping
motion_filter.interval_bigram_histogram: remove every bigram whose left or right interval token is exactly zero; retain only nonzero-to-nonzero pitch-motion bigrams
motion_filter.semantic_rule: repeated-note texture does not contribute to the primary composition-facing similarity

primary_representation.part_similarity: 0.5 * cosine(nonzero interval histogram) + 0.5 * cosine(nonzero-to-nonzero interval-bigram histogram)
primary_representation.part_correspondence: maximum-weight one-to-one assignment across active channels; physical channel number is not correspondence
primary_representation.track_similarity: arithmetic mean of matched part similarities
excluded_from_primary: physical channel number as cross-track identity
primary_representation.weights: fixed untuned 0.5/0.5 interval/bigram weighting inherited from Gen-2

golden_axe_iii.note: Development-only diagnostic after Gen-2 failure; margin and MRR nulls are not significant and are not represented as validation evidence.

sonic3d_complete_24_track.note: Development-only because Sonic 3D labels were already revealed by the failed Gen-2 validation.

sonic3d_direct_mapping_22_track.note: Development-only because Sonic 3D labels were already revealed by the failed Gen-2 validation.

hostile_negative.selected_tracks: all 16 tracks in the current public Mega Drive/Genesis pack
hostile_negative.role: unseen same-hardware, same-publisher, same-franchise-neighborhood negative control
hostile_negative.credit_note: Public pack credits Naofumi Hataya; the Golden Axe digital soundtrack breakdown also identifies two Masafumi Ogata tracks. Neither source assigns any Golden Axe II track to Tatsuyuki Maeda.

external_validation_metric.per_query_margin: best Maeda-reference similarity minus best non-Maeda-reference similarity
external_validation_metric.margin_sign_prediction: Maeda if margin > 0, non-Maeda if margin < 0; exact zero counts as incorrect
external_validation_metric.positive_world_sensitivity: fraction of J.League queries with positive margin
external_validation_metric.negative_world_specificity: fraction of Golden Axe II queries with negative margin
external_validation_metric.balanced_margin_sign_accuracy: mean of positive-world sensitivity and negative-world specificity
external_validation_metric.signed_margin: J.League uses +margin; Golden Axe II uses -margin
external_validation_metric.mean_signed_margin: mean signed margin across all 22 validation queries
external_validation_metric.top3_maeda_precision: fraction of the three nearest fixed-reference tracks labeled Maeda
external_validation_metric.top3_precision_lift: mean top3 Maeda precision minus fixed reference Maeda fraction

permutation_null.preserve: 20 Maeda / 24 non-Maeda reference counts and all validation query features/truths

no_rescue_rules: Do not change zero filtering, weights, assignment, k, thresholds, reference tracks, or validation track selection after inspecting either validation world's structural features.
Do not add a validation track to the reference bank.
Do not omit difficult J.League or Golden Axe II validation queries post hoc.
If any primary gate fails, Gen-3 fails and any further representation change requires Gen-4 preregistration.
Sonic 3 remains sealed on Gen-3 failure.
Even a passed Gen-3 supports only calibrated candidate similarity, never historical authorship without independent evidence.
